shots.prompt: One uninterrupted fourteen-second very wide coastal landscape shot from Picture 1, filmed in extreme slow motion with an absolutely fixed camera. Match the original unobstructed view from the open beach: the upper and left portions are clear open sky and sea exactly as in Picture 1. There is NO foreground tree, NO overhanging branch and NO foreground leaf anywhere in this frame. The original sea, distant horizon, pebble beach, road, poles, houses and sky remain visible at the same scale for the entire take. Gentle small waves breathe along the shore. The original small blue wing ornament at the bottom right is nearly at rest: across the ENTIRE FOURTEEN SECONDS it makes only ONE very gradual opening followed by ONE very gradual closing, a single calm breathing gesture, with long pauses. Both wings bend only at their shared central root. Keep its blue markings, original small size and corner location. Its motion is almost imperceptibly slow, never a rapidly beating flying insect. Keep the complete coast in view while it moves, with no camera approach, focus pull, pan, zoom, transition, cut or alternative scene. No added vegetation, object, person, human body, reflection, lettering, narration, voice, singing or humming. Leave the sky open for later titles.
